title: Marvin Bower Associate Professor
bio: Overview Professor Raffaelli's research focuses on the concept of reinvention. This work examines how organizations and leaders manage processes of innovation adoption, institutional change, and cognitive framing.

Raffaelli Marvin Bower Associate Professor Marvin Bower Associate Professor Ryan Raffaelli is the Marvin Bower Associate Professor of Business Administration at Harvard Business School. He created the MBA course Leadership: Execution and Action Planning ( LEAP ) and serves as faculty chair of Leading Change and Organizational Renewal (LCOR) in Executive Education. He teaches in a wide range of executive programs, including Leading and Building a Culture of Innovation ( LBCI ) and Leading in the Digital Era ( LDE ).
